lessons.explanation:
The passato prossimo uses avere or essere + past participle; with avere the participle stays the same, with essere it agrees with the subject.
Abbiamo già preparato la sala. — We have already prepared the room.
Giulia ha scritto il riassunto del progetto. — Giulia has written the project summary.
lessons.speakingPrompt: You and an Italian-speaking classmate are discussing reviewing what the team has finished. The passato prossimo uses avere or essere + past participle; with avere the participle stays the same, with essere it agrees with the subject. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.
